Future<void> pollIn(items, client) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await client.poll(item);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
}

Future<void> pollFor(client, int count) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    await client.poll(i);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
}

Future<void> pollWhile(client) async {
  while (client.active) {
    await client.poll();
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
}

Future<void> untypedPause(items, client) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await client.poll(item);
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
}

Future<void> notAPause(items, client, value) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(item);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future<void>.value(value);
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(i);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future<void>.value(value);
  }
  while (client.active) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll();
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future<void>.value(value);
  }
}

Future<void> anyIsNoPause(items, client, done, pause, wait) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(item);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future<void>.any([done.future, pause(wait)]);
  }
}

Future<void> otherClass(items, client, d) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(item);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Later<void>.delayed(d);
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(i);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Later<void>.delayed(d);
  }
  while (client.active) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll();
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Later<void>.delayed(d);
  }
}

Future<void> pauseAsValue(items, client, d) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(item);
    final pause = Future<void>.delayed(d);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await pause;
  }
}

Future<List<R>> chunkTypedAdd<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) op) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait<R>(group.map((item) => op(item))));
  }
  return results;
}
Future<void> chunkTypedStmt<T>(List<T> items, int width, op) async {
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    await Future.wait<void>(group.map((item) => op(item)));
  }
}
Future<void> chunkTypedEager<T>(List<T> items, int width, op) async {
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    await Future.wait<void>(group.map((item) => op(item)), eagerError: true);
  }
}
class Queue {
  final Set<Future<void>> pending = {};
  Future<void> drainWhole() async {
    while (pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait<void>(pending);
    }
  }
  Future<void> drainList() async {
    while (pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait<void>(pending.toList());
    }
  }
  Future<void> drainSpread() async {
    while (pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait<void>([...pending]);
    }
  }
  Future<void> drainEager() async {
    while (pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait<void>(pending, eagerError: true);
    }
  }
}
Future<List<R>> poolTyped<T, R>(List<T> items, int limit, Future<R> Function(T item) read) async {
 final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
 var next = 0;
 await Future.wait<void>(List.generate(limit, (_) async {
  while (next < items.length) {
   final index = next++;
   results[index] = await read(items[index]);
  }
 }));
 return results.cast<R>();
}
Future<void> inLoopTyped(items, read) async {
  for (final batch in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait<void>(batch.map(read));
  }
}
